{{Quote|You see, Serphidi was once a world of superior technology&mdash;but with that technology came the urge to use it for acts of destruction! Thus was our planet torn for centuries by endless, senseless wars. Until that wonderful day when sanity prevailed and a pact was signed, one that banned technology&mdash;and united all of Serphidi under the leadership of a single king.|[[Elglih]]|<ref name="marvel64" />}}
'''Serphidi''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="marvel64" /> in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]' [[Sanbra sector/Legends|Sanbra sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The fourth planet in the [[Belial system/Legends|Belial system]], Serphidi was blanketed in vine-draped [[Forest/Legends|forests]] that contained dangerous plant life&mdash;the planet was also home to the [[Serp]]s, a [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that used giant lizards as mounts and who built a thriving, high-tech society before tearing it apart with generations of violence. Eventually, the Serps united under one [[King/Legends|King]], rebuilding their society through banning technology and sublimating their violent urges in yearly jousting competitions. By [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-aligned King [[S'Shah]] ruled over Serphidi, deviating from Serp tradition by reintroducing high-tech weapons in his mortal [[Doom-Joust/Legends|Doom-Jousts]]. However, he was defeated and overthrown by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agent [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], who installed rival [[Elglih]] to the throne, promptly receiving Alliance support from Serphidi.<ref name="marvel64" />

==Behind the scenes==
Serphidi was the setting of [[Star Wars (1977) 64|''Star Wars'' (1977) 64]], written by [[David Michelinie]] and [[Michael Fleisher]], illustrated by [[Joe Brozowski]] and released in [[1982]].<ref name="marvel64" />
